description: [PAID $0.02 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Measure one agent and receive a signed, transportable attestation of its discoverability. Publish it on your site or give it to a directory: anyone can verify it offline via POST /agents/certify/verify (free). This is the difference between saying 'my agent is agent-ready' and proving it, dated and signed.
